description: Restructure agri_data_service (36,438 lines) into six layers with a lint-enforceable dependency rule, separating pure Monte Carlo and ML method code over a shared foundation, dissolving the 2,474-line cli.py into thin command wiring, and exposing a public importable SDK surface without changing any of the 52 CLI command strings

pivot_reconciliation_20260822.verdict: Phases 0-3 of 9 shipped and are real, in the tree, and unaffected by the pivot. Phases 4-8 are blocked: their target directories are the same ones §0.24's 21-stream plan just assigned to S1-S21, and continuing this track's own plan would collide with that assignment.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.what_shipped: Verified in the working tree 2026-08-22, not from the track's own optimistic status field (which still read 'planned'). Phase 0 (safety nets): tests/test_layer_import_contract.py exists and is the AST contract test the spec called for; it currently covers foundation, method, warehouse, pipeline, planes and interface with the spec's dependency table. Phase 1 (path-arithmetic fix): cli.py's _alembic_config() and db/sql_objects.py's _find_schema_root() both now read an explicit env var first (AGRI_ALEMBIC_CONFIG, AGRI_SCHEMA_ROOT) with an upward directory walk, and only fall back to the old parents[N] arithmetic as a last resort -- exactly the 'explicit setting with the current path as default' the plan specified. Phase 2 (foundation/): services/agri-data-service/src/agri_data_service/foundation/ exists with canonical.py and an AGENTS.md. Phase 3 (method/monte_carlo/, method/ml/): both exist as real packages -- method/monte_carlo/vegetation_ndvi_forecast.py, and method/ml/ holding strategy_selection.py, strategy_label_mapping.py, covariate_wind_model.py plus several modules added after the track was written (analog_ensemble.py, conformal_calibration.py, covariates_v2.py, expert_label_plane.py, recommendation_models.py, seasonal_candidates.py, seasonal_evaluation.py, seasonal_lineage_graph.py). Landed in commits 7d917d0 (2026-08-14) and 4a685a1 (2026-08-15), both pre-dating the 2026-08-22 pivot.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.what_did_not_ship: Phases 4-8 have not executed. warehouse/, pipeline/, planes/ and interface/ exist ONLY as stub directories -- one AGENTS.md and one empty __init__.py each, stating the intended L1-L4 responsibility but holding no moved code. db/, models/, ingest/, the historical_* family in execution/, cli.py and routes/ are all still fully populated at their original locations, untouched.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.the_conflict: §0.24.1's stream table assigns S16 ('Ingestion dual-write') the boundary '.../execution/**, .../ingest/**' -- the OLD paths -- and S1-S15 read from the same OLD execution/ing modules to build their lane exports. If Phase 5 of this track proceeded (moving ingest/ -> pipeline/ingest/ and the historical_* family -> pipeline/historical/), and Phase 4 proceeded (db/+models/ -> warehouse/), every one of those streams would be rewriting imports against a tree that is simultaneously being restructured by a different, larger concurrent effort -- the exact two-large-restructurings-of-one-tree collision the wave plan's disjoint file boundaries exist to prevent. A second, narrower but concrete conflict already exists in what HAS shipped: §0.24.5 says ML 'moves to .../agri_data_service/ml/ as its own area', but ML code already lives at method/ml/ (nested under the layering track's L1, not a top-level ml/) as of 2026-08-14/15. The two plans disagree on ML's home path, and neither runbook section shows awareness of the other's naming.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.recommendation: §0.24 governs going forward -- it is the newer, owner-authorized, currently-executing plan, and eleven-plus streams are about to write against its directory contract. Concretely: (1) Do not resume agri_sdk_layering Phases 4-8 as specified; their scope is superseded by the lane restructuring of the same trees. (2) Phases 0-3's shipped output (foundation/, method/ml/, method/monte_carlo/, the two path-arithmetic fixes, test_layer_import_contract.py) should be RETAINED, not unwound -- it is real, tested, and does not collide with any S0-S21 file boundary as declared. (3) The owner should resolve the method/ml/ vs top-level ml/ naming discrepancy explicitly before S0 (foundation) work proceeds much further, either by renaming method/ml/ -> ml/ (small, mechanical, keeps the ML-freeze intact since nothing there changes behaviourally) or by amending §0.24.5's own path reference to acknowledge method/ml/ as ML's actual current home. Left unresolved, whichever stream first touches ML boundaries risks creating a second, competing ml/ directory. (4) Status is 'blocked' rather than 'superseded' because Phases 0-3's value is not in question -- what is blocked is a decision only the owner can make about phases 4-8 and the ml/ path.

dependency_mode: Python only, inside services/agri-data-service/src/agri_data_service. No Alembic revision, no Drizzle migration, no DDL, no schema change, no DML. Phase 6 edits infra/cron-ingest/Dockerfile comments only; the nine infra/cron-*/railway.json startCommand strings and the pyproject.toml agri-cli entry point are frozen for the whole track. Overlaps the parallel SQL-extraction convention work on exactly two files; the plan's sequencing section holds the freeze protocol.
activation_gate: Phase 0 must land first and independently: the golden 52-leaf command surface fixture, the AST layering contract test, and the cron container smoke script must all be green against an unmodified tree before any code moves. Phase 1 must precede every move because two modules resolve paths by __file__ depth and relocate silently wrong. Phase 6 is the only phase permitted to restructure cli.py; it ships as 6a then 6b in separate releases, with at least one full weekly cron cycle (cron-drought, 0 14 * * 4) observed green between them. Phase 3 is blocked on the owner's answer to spec open question 1 (covariate_wind_model.py reader/estimator split) and Phase 4 on open question 2.

resolution.phases_4_to_8_superseded_20260822: Owner decision 2026-08-22 (RUNBOOK 0.25.1): ingest/ and execution/ stay as first-class packages and get per-domain sub-packages, rather than being dissolved into warehouse/pipeline/planes/interface. Phases 0-3 (the six-layer lattice and tests/test_layer_import_contract.py) REMAIN IN FORCE. cli.py is not dissolved now.

archive_reason: Phases 0-3 SHIPPED and still in force -- the six-layer lattice and its import contract are load-bearing for all twelve Parquet streams. Phases 4-8 are SUPERSEDED, not deferred: RUNBOOK 0.25.1 decisions 1/2/4 keep ingest/ and execution/ as first-class homes layered internally by domain, instead of dissolving them into warehouse/pipeline/planes/interface.
